reason: I already pay for vidIQ and use maybe half of it, so I don't need another tool, and I don't know who runs this one. Even read-only, I'm not handing a new app access to my channel on the strength of a pitch.
objection: I don't want an unknown app to have access to my YouTube channel, even if it says it's read-only and asks for my OK before posting anything.
would_change_my_mind: A known company or creator I trust vouches for it, or I can use the free tier for a few weeks and see it give me a title or thumbnail that clearly beats my usual views.
